mechanism.claim: Volatile BTC auctions can contain diffuse two-sided flow or a few concentrated directional aggressive-flow bursts. A high absolute signed HHI of completed five-minute taker imbalances identifies the latter state; follow the concentrated side for eight hours.
mechanism.side: strict sign of signed taker-imbalance concentration
mechanism.why_distinct: HVTIFP measures lag-one dependence among normalized imbalances and HVTISI measures one aggregate imbalance against its same-slot history. HVTICC instead measures sign-weighted cross-bin concentration of dollar taker imbalance. It uses no serial correlation, seasonal baseline, price direction, funding, OI, premium, cross-asset input, fitted outcome, prior event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed BTC eight-hour variation must occupy its causal upper 35 percent while absolute signed flow concentration occupies its causal upper quartile
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: offset signed flow-concentration onsets are absent from Gross9 structural primitives

features.source_window: 480 exact unique coherent bars_binance BTCUSDT interval=1m rows [D-8h,D)
features.five_minute_bins: 96 exact consecutive five-minute groups, each containing five exact minute rows
features.signed_concentration: sum(f_i*abs(f_i))/square(sum(abs(f_i))); finite strict nonzero with strict positive denominator
features.interpretation: a scale-free signed HHI: magnitude rises when one directional side dominates a few five-minute bins
features.concentration_rank: strict-prior midrank of abs(signed_concentration) over at most 270 earlier source-valid decisions, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.75
features.btc_returns: 95 close-to-close natural-log returns from 96 exact five-minute closes
features.realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared btc_returns), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 earlier source-valid decisions, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.onset: eligible now and immediately preceding scheduled source-valid decision ineligible; missing or invalid predecessor cannot trigger

clock.decision: D after all flow and price minutes complete
clock.reservation: global chronological half-open; exit first on equal entry
clock.funding: not signal input; exact held settlements only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp/10bp per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent temporal concentration of aggressive dollar-flow imbalance

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no aggregation, signed-HHI formula, rank, onset, variation, side, clock, hold, subset, threshold, comparator, or control repair
